title: The Hollow Wolf Revisited
author: Wren Marchetti
blurb: Silas Sandoval, a debt-bound temple scribe, has never left the valley where magic cannot follow. Then a child arrives at the door speaking a language that predates kingdoms — and she is pulled straight into the middle of it. To get through this, she must carry a secret that could reignite an ancient war before the last dragon-fire gutters out.
style: warm, character-driven storytelling with gentle humor
